battlecards.why_selected: Retained due to specialized hardware configuration knowledge and willingness to reduce pricing after benchmarking.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pricing concessions applied to existing MSA; no term change disclosed.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of competitive bid and volume visibility.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Deep product expertise with Arotech’s simulation hardware; proven delivery.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Limited competition in niche configurations kept savings to 4%.
battlecards.switching_costs: Hardware requalification and potential production delays.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided best overall pricing on high-volume AV items and could integrate with existing IT hardware program.
battlecards.contract_terms: Catalog pricing with quarterly review; no volume commitment stated.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Large consolidated spend ($2.5M) and competition among four national resellers.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Broad line card, existing relationship on IT side, strong logistics.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Requires minimum order size for free freight.
battlecards.notes: Connection will also absorb a portion of previous Amazon hardware spend.

battlecards.why_selected: Matched Amazon SKU list and agreed to flat 5% discount with dedicated account support.
battlecards.contract_terms: Price file tied to matched SKUs; review every 6 months.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to redirect ~$680K of unmanaged Amazon spend.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Lower landed cost, centralized invoicing, tax-exempt processing.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Slightly longer lead times than Amazon Prime.
battlecards.switching_costs: User training to order through Connection portal.

battlecards.why_selected: OMNIA GPO contract delivered 13-32% lower daily rates with no participation fee.
battlecards.contract_terms: Participation agreement with OMNIA; no volume commitment; rates locked for 2 years.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggregate buying power of OMNIA membership and demonstrated savings analysis.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Large location network; Emerald Aisle benefits; centralized billing.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Some premium classes showed minimal savings.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—same supplier, just new billing codes.
battlecards.notes: Arotech must complete DocuSign forms to activate new billing codes.

battlecards.why_selected: Maintained for breadth of catalog and existing punch-out integration; matched select Fastenal pricing.
battlecards.contract_terms: Existing Grainger agreement retained; supplemental Fastenal option added.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of shifting high-margin lines to Fastenal.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Next-day delivery, wide SKU availability, established terms.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing on specific categories (e.g., plumbing).
battlecards.switching_costs: System integrations and established user familiarity.
battlecards.notes: Savings concentrated in categories where Fastenal outperformed Grainger.

battlecards.why_selected: Offered 18-50% lower pricing on targeted categories such as plumbing and adhesives.
battlecards.contract_terms: OMNIA participation agreement; no volume commitment.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to shift spend away from Grainger created concessions.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Competitive category pricing, branch network, vendor-managed inventory options.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low; purchases will be spot buys on identified categories.
battlecards.notes: Projected to capture spend in seven high-savings segments.

battlecards.why_selected: 10% off BAR across 17 IHG brands with seamless Egencia integration.
battlecards.contract_terms: Business Edge enrollment; rates loaded in Egencia; annual review.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Volume data and commitment to drive 50% of stays to IHG.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Global footprint; loyalty benefits; self-service rate loading.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Requires travelers to choose IHG to realize savings.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low – opt-out of program at any time.

battlecards.supplier_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Ann Arbor
alternatives_considered: Continue booking at retail rate in Ann Arbor market
battlecards.why_selected: Offered fixed $105 nightly rate including breakfast and parking.
battlecards.contract_terms: Rate valid through 12/31/2023; non-last room availability.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Consolidated 126 annual nights into single property commitment.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Proximity to HQ, reliable availability, complimentary services.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Rate is NLRA – blackout risk at peak times.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low – individual traveler booking preference changes.
